svg.text: Minefields - the look and the authoring (CE-4624 MS-U1)

Grey annotations are not drawn by the app. Scope: the field's 2-D/3-D drawing, the area tool's minefield arm + lane line, the Minefield form, the clearer's kit + icon, the bursts. Everything else is context, unchanged.
2-D map - ONE field, three viewers (MinefieldGizmo; the generic overlay never draws it; P-3 gate: off = truth for everyone)
Instructor, or the side-knowledge gate OFF: the TRUTH
every mine (AP dot, AT square), the struck one, the cleared lane
Blue seat, gate ON: what Blue KNOWS (its knowledge grid, 10 m cells)
amber suspected (50 m) · red known-mined · green known-clear
the strike: Blue suspects 50 m round it at once
no outline, no dots: Blue has not seen the field - only its cells
Blue seat, the field MARKED (or own, known at start)
outline + hatch + edge symbols + Blue's lane; no single mines
3-D map - a field is invisible until known; known = outline on the ground; MARKED = pickets and signs; the bursts; the clearer
the lane: churned earth + white pickets
marked field: red triangle signs on pickets along the edge (a known, unmarked field: the dashed outline only)
instructor only: the mines as discs
AP: a small dust burst at the foot
AT: a tall dark column under the hull
The mine clearer (TKB 116 Engineer_MineClearer) - flail / plough + line charge
flail: the drum spins (PartRole time-driven), chains lash, dust
flail loop sound while the flail is ON; mines in its swath burst harmlessly
2-D: the vehicle box + the engineer glyph
Authoring - the ONE area tool's minefield arm (a closed polyline) and the lane (the area tool in LINE mode)
Add lane: two clicks, 4.5 m wide
drawing: click the corners, close on the first point / double-click; the mines preview as you draw (MF-2)
Minefield: click corners, double-click or the first point to close · Esc cancels
Shape locked: 1 mine has gone off in this field - delete and re-lay it to change the outline
refused edit (MR-8): a struck field's corners do not move; the hint line says why; type / spacing / lanes still edit
Details - the Minefield form (one edit per change, undoable; the same rows as the animal area's form)
AP: any person or vehicle · AT: vehicles only
between mines in a row and between rows (staggered)
the rows' bearing; the handle on the map edits it too
a side that knows it avoids it (MF-15)
arms the area tool in line mode: two clicks (MR-18)
the outline is the field's ONE editable polyline (its vertices on the map); the form holds only the parameters (MR-8)
the mine counts are derived (MF-2) - nothing per mine is stored
